identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-12] Run opt-in soak and prove rollback

values.task_boundary: Prepare a durable reviewed execution packet and dependency gate for WP-12; do not run the soak or rollback harness, mutate a selector, implement product behavior, open a PR, publish, cut over, delete code, use AWS/raw gh, or edit Runtime v2.
deliverables: All six current-registry typed cards with exact scope, authority, dependencies, and no-deferral truth
Reversible soak/rollback design and Mermaid diagram
Exact #5350/#5361 live-merge, typed-closeout, retained-receipt, and ancestry gate
Manifest-driven local, CI, Runtime v3, provider-disposition, and demo soak contract
Successful-selection and failed-selection exact rollback proof contract
Selector failure-preservation and rollback verification matrix
COTS decision, protected paths, LoC/module/test/time budgets, PVF classes, and exact-review plan
Normalized redacted exact-revision report and reviewed handoff gate to #5343
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Product execution starts only when #5350 and #5361 are each GitHub merged, typed closed_out with no active claim, backed by a retained merged terminal receipt, and the receipt merge SHA is ancestral to the exact #5344 revision

AC-2: One canonically ordered immutable manifest identifies every local, CI, Runtime v3, provider-disposition, demo, negative, and rollback scenario with exact input, command, expected claim class, timeout, and artifact digest

AC-3: The harness snapshots prior selector bytes, digest, schema, generation, executable digest, and installation receipt, verifies an isolated root, and performs opt-in only through the authoritative locked compare-and-swap selector interface

AC-4: Successful selection, failed selection, failed soak, stale expectation, invalid or missing receipt, lock contention, interruption, and verification mismatch prove byte-preserving failure or explicit rollback through the same selector transaction

AC-5: Every path that selects the opt-in generation ends by re-reading and proving exact restoration of the prior selector bytes and digest; restoration failure blocks #5343, WP-13, publication, and closeout

AC-6: The retained report is deterministic, repo-relative, redacted, exact-revision and exact-tool-version bound, and distinguishes live, local or mock, credential-blocked, not-applicable, pass, fail, and non-claim dispositions without production overclaim

AC-7: #5344 never changes the default generation, never edits selector storage directly, never edits Runtime v2, and hands off to #5343 only after exact review accepts soak, rollback, compatibility-window, and residual-risk evidence

AC-8: Preparation, dependency, rollback, soak, budget, CI, and post-merge PVF lanes are executable and complete with no deferred acceptance; orchestration stays within 800 nonblank lines, tests and fixtures within 1,200, modules below 500, and 120/300/1800/3600-second budgets unless exact reviewed variance is recorded
dependencies: #5350 WP-11 live merged, typed closed_out, claim released, retained merged receipt present, and merge SHA ancestral
#5361 Runtime v3 acceptance live merged, typed closed_out, claim released, retained merged receipt present, and merge SHA ancestral
#5345 authoritative selector and installer public interface available as a read-only dependency on current main
Reviewed parity classifications and accepted Runtime v3 scenarios available at exact revisions
Child #5343 remains blocked until #5344 exact evidence is reviewed and accepted
repo_inputs: future retained closeout receipts and merged revisions for #5350 and #5361
future reviewed selector interface from #5345 and accepted scenario manifests from #5350/#5361
non_goals: Default generation selection or implementation of child #5343
Selector, installer, language, compiler, engine, records, provider, governed-tool, Runtime, or C-SDLC implementation
Incumbent ADL or Runtime v2 source changes, deletion, copying, linking, or cleanup
AWS, cloud provisioning, live credential acquisition, raw provider payload retention, or production-provider claims from mock evidence
WP-13 deletion, integrated release, milestone closeout, or v0.92 handoff
Any product implementation, soak execution, selector mutation, publication, PR, or closeout during this preparation task
